summary.en: This back-matter page collects the printable Check Yourself questions and their answers from the end of subsections across Essentials of Linguistics, 2nd edition. It gathers self-tests spanning Chapters 1 through 14 — language science, language and power, phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics, language variation and change, language acquisition, and historical linguistics — while sections still in preparation are marked Coming soon. Learners can use it to review each chapter at their own pace.
summary.zh: 本页是《语言学基础》第二版全书各小节末尾“自测题”的可打印汇总，按章收录题目与答案。内容覆盖第 1 至第 14 章，涉及语言科学、语言与权力、语音学、音系学、形态学、句法学、语义学、语用学、语言变异与变化、语言习得及历史语言学等主题，尚未完成的章节以“即将推出”标注。学习者可按章复习、逐题自测。

points.en: Chapter 1: what counts as language, implicit versus explicit knowledge, descriptive versus prescriptive statements, and the harms and benefits of language science.
points.zh: 第 1 章：何为语言、隐性知识与显性知识、描写性陈述与规定性陈述，以及语言科学造成的伤害与带来的益处。

points.en: Chapter 2: power and privilege in language, singular they, unstoppable language change, matched-guise experiments, and linguistic discrimination in hiring.
points.zh: 第 2 章：语言中的权力与特权、单数 they、无法阻挡的语言变化、匹配语伪装实验，以及招聘中的语言歧视。

points.en: Chapter 3: phonetic modality, the speech articulators, consonant place and phonation and manner, vowel quality, and reading the International Phonetic Alphabet.
points.zh: 第 3 章：语音模态、发音器官、辅音的发音部位与发声及发音方式、元音音质，以及国际音标的认读。

points.en: Chapter 7: linguistic versus non-linguistic meaning, compositionality, entailment, presupposition and implicature, the mental lexicon, thematic roles, countability, denotation and negative polarity items.
points.zh: 第 7 章：语言意义与非语言意义、组合性原则、蕴涵、预设与会话含义、心理词库、可数性与负极项。

points.en: Chapter 8 and Appendix 1: at-issue versus non-at-issue meaning, phrase structure rules, heads, recursion, tree properties, structural ambiguity, and movement in questions.
points.zh: 第 8 章与附录 1：断言意义与非断言意义、短语结构规则、中心语、递归、结构歧义，以及疑问句中的移位。

points.en: Chapter 11: infant speech perception, the word gap, early word combinations and syntax, and word meanings; several chapters remain Coming soon.
points.zh: 第 11 章：婴儿语音感知、词汇量差距、早期词语组合与句法、词义发展；其余多章仍标注为即将推出。

terms.defEn: A claim about how language actually works, based on observation rather than judgement.
terms.defZh: 基于观察、说明语言实际如何运作的陈述，而非对语言好坏的价值判断。

terms.defEn: An experiment holding a message constant while varying the accent or speaker guise.
terms.defZh: 一种实验方法：保持所传达的信息不变，只改变口音或说话人伪装，以考察听者态度。

terms.defEn: A speech organ that does not normally move and is approached by an active articulator.
terms.defZh: 通常不主动移动、由主动发音器官向其靠近而形成阻碍的发音器官。

terms.defEn: The meaning of a complex expression comes from its parts and how they combine.
terms.defZh: 复杂表达式的意义由其组成部分的意义以及这些部分的组合方式共同决定。

terms.defEn: Background meaning taken for granted by a sentence rather than asserted by it.
terms.defZh: 句子在说出时所默认接受、而非直接断言的那一部分背景意义。

terms.defEn: A rule property letting a phrase contain another phrase of the same type.
terms.defZh: 一条规则允许某类短语内部再包含同类短语，从而使结构可以无限嵌套。

examples.text: The sentence, “Sam bumped the passenger with the rolling suitcase,” has at least two different meanings. It could mean that Sam had the suitcase and bumped the passenger, or that the passenger had the suitcase and Sam bumped them. Which part of the grammar leads to these two different meanings?
examples.noteEn: A Chapter 1 item using structural ambiguity to test knowledge of grammar components.
examples.noteZh: 第 1 章题目，借结构歧义考查对语法各组成部分的认识。

examples.text: Question 3.3-2. Which of the following are passive articulators in the vocal tract? Select all that apply.
examples.noteEn: A Chapter 3 phonetics item on identifying passive articulators in the vocal tract.
examples.noteZh: 第 3 章语音学题目，要求辨认声道中的被动发音器官。

examples.text: Question 7.2-2. True or false: All DPs are referential in their meaning.
examples.noteEn: A Chapter 7 semantics item probing compositionality and reference.
examples.noteZh: 第 7 章语义学题目，考查组合性原则与指称之间的关系。

examples.text: Question A1.3-3. Which two of the following groups of rules are recursive?
examples.noteEn: An Appendix 1 syntax item asking students to spot recursive phrase structure rules.
examples.noteZh: 附录 1 句法题目，要求指出哪些短语结构规则具有递归性。

body.en: This page is the printable version of the interactive Check Yourself questions that appear at the end of each subsection in Essentials of Linguistics, 2nd edition. It is organized by chapter and subsection, so each heading names the topic being tested and the questions are followed by a short answer key. Because it spans the whole book, the page works as a single review resource: you can read it straight through as a cumulative self-test, or jump to the chapter you have just finished.
body.zh: 本页是《语言学基础》第二版中每个小节末尾互动式“自测题”的可打印版本，按章和小节编排：每个标题标明所考查的主题，题目之后附有简短答案。由于它横跨全书，这一页可以当作完整的复习资源使用：既可以通读一遍，作为累积式自测，也可以直接跳到刚学完的那一章。

body.en: The questions come in several formats. Some are multiple-choice, true-or-false, matching, ranking or check-all-that-apply items with a definite answer in the key. Others ask you to examine data, compare dialects, draw or interpret a syntax tree, or reflect on your own experience of language and power. For the open-ended questions the source simply says that answers will vary, which is the point: they are meant to prompt analysis and discussion rather than a single correct response.
body.zh: 题目形式多样。有些是选择题、判断题、配对题、排序题或“选出所有正确项”，答案部分给出明确解答；另一些则要求你分析语料、比较方言、绘制或解读句法树形图，或反思自己在语言与权力方面的亲身经历。对于开放性问题，原文只写“答案因人而异”，而这正是要点所在：它们意在引发分析与讨论，而不是追求唯一正确答案。

body.en: Use the page as a diagnostic tool rather than a memorization list. After each chapter, answer the items without looking at the key, then compare your reasoning with the explanations. Note the caveats: a few chapters and sections are still marked Coming soon, and some questions refer to images or interactive tasks, so the printable text alone may not capture everything. Where a question has no fixed answer, treat your written response as the record of your understanding.
body.zh: 请把这一页当作诊断工具，而不是背诵清单。学完每一章后，先不看答案作答，再把自己的推理过程与解析对照。也要留意局限：部分章节与小节仍标注为“即将推出”，有些题目还依赖图片或互动操作，仅看可打印文本未必能完整呈现。遇到没有固定答案的题目时，不妨把自己的书面回答当作理解程度的记录。
